Tests recent blockhash sysvar bounds, init, update, and queue contents.

# Purpose
This file is a test source for the `recent_block_hashes` sysvar. It checks the binary layout, size, and alignment of the encoded data, and it verifies that the sysvar can be created and updated through the bank and account database interfaces. The tests also confirm that the sysvar is not valid before the rent sysvar exists, and that it becomes valid after initialization and cache restore.

The main test logic exercises the link between the sysvar cache and the bank blockhash queue. It creates a blockhash queue, sets the bank PoH hash and fee data, calls `fd_sysvar_recent_hashes_update`, and then reads the cached sysvar data back to check the stored count, hash values, and fee calculator values. It then adds many hashes to confirm that the queue keeps the expected 150 entries and that each cached entry matches the blockhash queue state.
